title: Tape Chewed
caption: Lo-fi gospel beat, a cassette of a church organ and a small choir that is being chewed by the tape machine: wow and flutter, sagging pitch, dropouts and hiss. A heavy boom-bap kick and a cracking snare pump the whole sample down with every hit. Overdriven sub bass, chopped choir stabs retriggered like a sampler, and a distorted fuzz bass line that takes over in the second half. Nostalgic, woozy, warm, slowly falling apart.
